source.represents: UK Sanctions List (UKSL), FCDO, sole UK source since 2026-01-28
source.license_note: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a license.

schema_note: customer shaped like Identomat session person object; candidate shaped like get-screening-person-details (shared with FP generator).
label_definition: true positive = a customer who genuinely is a UK-listed person, captured with realistic divergence that preserves identity
caveat: True positives only. Merge with the false-positive set at a realistic base rate (FPs heavily outnumber TPs) before scoring.
